points.title: Build system and reproducibility
points.notes: Immutable 11adaa1 clean CMake configure fails: CMakeLists.txt:51 requires src/restart.cpp, absent from submission. Network-disabled cfd-bench with /opt/external dependencies locates MPI and configures through dependency checks before missing-source error. Untracked workspace placeholder exists but is post-session and not submitted at immutable tip.

points.title: CLI and error handling
points.notes: main.cpp:63–99 parses solve/restart/report options; solver.cpp:397–415 loads current restart only and ignores stored time/step and previous BDF state.

points.title: Code organization and extensibility
points.notes: Distinct case, mesh, partition, gradient, flux, solver and output modules; 2-D state types couple implementation.

points.title: Originality and license compliance
points.notes: No source-evident internal solver executable wrapper; external authorship/similarity not searched under trust policy.

points.title: No hard-coded case logic
points.notes: mesh.cpp:89 CGNS reader accepts configured path and zones; no two-filename branch found. Reader supports task meshes; broader compatibility not tested.

points.title: MPI correctness
points.notes: main.cpp:91–99 loads mesh on each rank for preprocessing, then resets it before solver; partition.cpp:49 calls METIS and solver.cpp:95–103 exchanges neighbor state. No credible completed rank comparison.

points.title: Robustness and memory sanity
points.notes: Canonical steady runs all fail after 500 steps; four end NaN. solver.cpp:535–548 honestly marks failed but blindly proceeds through nonfinite states; temporal history is wrong.

points.title: Testing and validation evidence
points.notes: Committed mesh_probe.cpp and partition_probe.cpp print diagnostics; no numerical assertions or independent solver convergence tests found. Curated solver configure itself fails.

points.title: Code hygiene
points.notes: CMakeLists.txt:51 references omitted restart.cpp; raw results excluded as designed. Small modules exist but immutable source cannot clean-configure.

disqualification_flags.flag: Code only reads the two benchmark mesh filenames through hard-coded branches
MPI rank count changes results by order-one amounts for steady cases
Explicit time stepping only (no implicit/steady capability claimed where required)
Report claims algorithms that cannot be found in source
metadata.json marks incomplete/failed runs as successful
Solver core, time integration, or MPI communication copied/adapted/wrapped from an existing open-source CFD codebase
